Lost acknowledgments may mean unknown. Empty logs/discarded context prove no absence. Completed effects can coexist with falsified Product outcome.

Missing required reason leaves the claimed predicate indeterminate and that contribution inadmissible as deciding support; preserve raw outcome/authentication gap, while independently admissible counterevidence/diagnoses retain legal standing without invented execution. grounding.quote:
1. Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes

   explicit alongside it.
2. With no such falsification, an invalid required basis prevents satisfaction
   and yields `invalid_basis`; a required out-of-frame judgment yields

3. Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable

4. `satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established. An empty list
   proves nothing unless the declared required set is established as empty.

constraints.statement: Required coverage derives from the composite applicability/coverage contract, not received returns. Authenticate producer, subject, basis and planned membership; unauthenticated claims discharge nothing, absent planned judgments and required coverage outside the authenticated plan remain distinct, and invalid contributions cannot erase independent findings. Applying the combining rule is performed without changing component performance. For an interpretable composite: authenticated applicable required predicate/join falsification dominates, retaining gaps; otherwise invalid required basis precedes required out_of_frame; otherwise unresolved applicability/evaluation/predicate/join gives indeterminate; satisfied requires all applicable obligations/joins authentically satisfied and established coverage, including proof if the required set is empty. Declare admission versus material-join roles: failed admission prevents interpretation, false admitted joins are counterevidence, not relabeled missing basis. Effect uncertainty blocks only predicates requiring the relevant known effect state.

conditions: Composite effects are evaluated.

grounding.quote:
Over the resulting disjoint part observations: any unknown gives unknown;
all not_requested gives not_requested; completed with only completed or
not_requested gives completed; not_started with only not_started or
not_requested gives not_started; reverted with only reverted, not_started or
not_requested gives reverted; every remaining fully observed mixture gives
partial. Retain each observation's part and contributing components. The combining
operation's own lack of mutation cannot label an effectful composite not_requested.

constraints.statement: Declare composite boundary and parts; resolve each part's current observation retaining identity, ordering, contributions and supported supersession. Later timestamps alone do not supersede; conflict/insufficiency yields unknown. Normalize every material possible part, including absent-slot effects, under core effect law. Sequential local completions must map to the part's composite state: completed deployment then rollback is reverted; reapplication is completed with rollback history retained. Keep irreversible external parts. On normalized disjoint observations, any unknown → unknown; all not_requested → not_requested; at least one completed with only completed/not_requested → completed; at least one not_started with only not_started/not_requested → not_started; at least one reverted with only reverted/not_started/not_requested → reverted; other fully observed mixtures → partial. A mutation-free combiner cannot make an effectful composite not_requested.

conditions: A declared logical operator, sequential composition or regrouping is used.
exceptions: Recovery outer predicates need not require an earlier failed test to become true; all-stage-postcondition pipelines do use conjunction.

grounding.quote:
verdict cannot establish this equivalence. This grants no associativity to an
arbitrary declared operator; regrouping it requires preservation of the same

operations additionally needs an effect-independence law; associativity alone

constraints.statement: Declare exact leaf/join truth/falsity conditions disjoint and exhaustive on the fully decided admitted domain; overlap, incompleteness or uninterpretable declarations are invalid_basis, unresolved well-formedness indeterminate with valid leaves retained. Once well-formed, satisfaction needs authenticated truth-condition evidence and required joins/coverage; falsification needs established falsity; otherwise material invalid_basis precedes out_of_frame, then indeterminate, considering only dependencies needed to decide the predicate. Negation/disjunction are different predicates and cannot erase failed leaves or masquerade as conjunction; undecided fallback is not success. Unreturned dependent evaluations remain absent slots with performance/extent/missing conclusion. Regrouping requires fixed interpretable basis, leaves, joins, normalized parts and authentication, hiding no intermediate basis failure; component-set union, conjunction precedence and disjoint effect join are associative on that domain. Arbitrary operators require their own associativity proof and preserved outer predicate; reordering additionally needs effect independence. Sequential outer results follow owning contracts and preservation arguments; unknown interpretation/join yields appropriate unresolved/invalid result, never guessed success or fabricated stages.

conditions: A step, invariant, end-to-end preservation or approximation claim is made.
exceptions: Supported local claims remain usable when joins/final implication are unresolved, but do not establish the outer claim; unproved universals stop only work requiring their proof.

grounding.quote:
Establish the initial condition, each step's applicable premises and the
composition boundaries before using the steps as an end-to-end argument. A
preceding postcondition must establish the next precondition; otherwise acquire
and justify the missing condition. Establish that the final property implies
Z. Supported local claims remain usable when a required join or final implication
is unresolved, but they do not establish that outer claim. For an invariant,
induction requires its initial case and preservation on every admitted step;
neither an invariant nor repeated execution proves progress or termination.

constraints.statement: Establish initial conditions, every step's premises and composition boundaries; preceding postconditions must establish next preconditions or missing conditions must be acquired/justified; final property must imply Z. Invariant induction needs initial case and every admitted-step preservation, not merely repetition, and proves no progress/termination. Cover every material outcome/effect/assumption, not only success; refusal/failure/interruption/unknown effects retain result/recovery contracts. Actual execution conformance is separate; concurrency, branches and external effects need their own composition laws. Exact transforms preserve declared meaning; approximations declare adequacy and a whole-composition bound not established by local tolerances alone. Cross-account maps need preservation support; formulas, mathematical arguments, structural checks, finite models, samples and observations retain distinct reach. Human/machine/mixed execution alone discharges none of these.

conditions: An assertion is used to decide an owning obligation.
exceptions: Equality may be a justified oracle for a declared narrower regression target, retaining its scope.

grounding.quote:
These are conditional on Gamma and Omega. A pass on a necessary condition
cannot establish Q_r. A collection of assertions needs its own coverage and
compatibility argument before its conjunction establishes Q_r. Valid different
realisations may satisfy Q_r with different outputs. Equality can be an oracle
for a justified declared target q_t, including a narrower regression property;
the conclusion retains that target and scope. Establish its relation to Q_r
before using it to decide the source obligation. Equality alone cannot reject
permitted alternatives or prove full obligation satisfaction.

constraints.statement: Justify Q_r's interpretation with conditions, exceptions and alternatives; identifiers/digests prove selected text, not fidelity. State whether q_t is Q_r or narrower. Under Gamma/Omega, Q_r⇒q_t establishes necessity; q_t⇒Q_r establishes sufficiency; a conjunction⇒Q_r needs coverage/compatibility support. Passing a necessary condition does not establish Q_r. Permitted realizations can have different outputs; equality alone cannot reject alternatives or prove full obligation satisfaction.

conditions: A checker claims soundness or always-correct decisions from observations.
exceptions: Additional independently admissible evidence retains normal standing despite limited observations.

grounding.quote:
If equally observed admissible cases disagree on q_t, acquire distinguishing
evidence, justify a narrower scope, or return indeterminate on that attempted
decision. In a classical set model the condition permits a predicate on the
image of pi; it provides neither an executable decision procedure nor a cost
bound. Additional independently admissible evidence retains its normal core
standing; the limited observation is not permission to erase it.

constraints.statement: For every s∈Omega, (pi(s),sat)∈T must imply q_t(s), and (pi(s),fal)∈T must imply not q_t(s); identify support/unresolved premises for each direction. Deterministic checking is a functional special case; human/probabilistic universal soundness covers every admitted conclusion, not a favorable run. A sound relation may admit satisfied and indeterminate without always deciding and supplies no probability distribution. Restricted checker scope, actual checker conformance and observation acquisition need support; ideal pi does not prove actual acquisition. Reported passes/failures remain observations until oracle/observation justification supports conclusions, retaining predicate/performance/effects. Always deciding correctly from pi alone requires for all s,s', pi(s)=pi(s')⇒q_t(s)=q_t(s'). Indistinguishable disagreeing cases require distinguishing evidence, justified narrowing or indeterminate; classical factorization through pi's image proves neither algorithm nor cost bound.

exceptions: Shared derivations may serve declared test families without one document per test.

grounding.quote:
Mutual assurance compares justified constructions or assertions on their stated
scope. Agreement admits shared error as well as correctness; disagreement
requires diagnosis and does not identify the faulty party by itself. Account for
material shared specifications, interpretations, tools, fixtures, observations,
copied contributions and other failure causes. Different actors, families or
codebases do not establish statistical independence. Repeating an observation
does not make it new independent evidence; required authorship independence
applies [Independent assessment](#independent-assessment).

constraints.statement: Assurance depends on each refinement's justification, not length/label; requirement-derived and refinement-derived assertions do not automatically cover each other. Preserve assertion and execution provenance; logs cannot justify expected answers. Implementation-derived assertions support regression/local properties but repeating code decisions supplies no independent upstream justification. Shorter paths need demonstrated cost benefit and imply no correctness/coverage/independence. Agreement permits shared error, disagreement needs diagnosis, and different actors/families/codebases or repeated observations establish no statistical independence. Account for shared specifications, interpretations, tools, fixtures, observations, copied contributions and other causes. Required authorship independence follows its own contract. Agreement in a wrong common model cannot validate that model; validation uses declared purpose and owned external observations, preserving counterexamples and routing corrections through bounded construction.

exceptions: Unsupported numerical confidence remains unresolved while qualitative evidence remains usable within policy and stated limits.

grounding.quote:
Sampled cases or injected defects calibrate only their justified relation to
operational failures. Unsupported numerical confidence remains unresolved;
qualitative evidence remains usable within governing policy and stated limits.
No universal probability threshold or per-test probability estimate is required.
The assurance and risk policy constrain cost selection rather than disappearing
when a cheaper plan is available.

constraints.statement: Bind coverage, uncertainty and action/acceptance conditions; more evidence helps only within applicability/dependence, never by counts alone. Safety/authority/acceptance requirements persist under every strategy and cheaper plans. Quantification requires population/model, prior, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration. Bayes: P(V|E,Gamma)=P(E|V,Gamma)P(V|Gamma)/[P(E|V,Gamma)P(V|Gamma)+P(E|not V,Gamma)P(not V|Gamma)], with nonzero denominator and all conditionals defined; the equation supplies no missing inputs and agreement need not increase confidence under changed shared-cause models. Joint miss probability equals the product over i of P(M_i|V,Gamma,M_1,...,M_(i-1)) on defined conditioning events; handle zero-probability prefixes without invented conditionals. Replacing factors by P(M_i|V,Gamma) requires relevant conditional independence. One minus joint miss is at-least-one detection probability, not whole-Product correctness. Samples/injected defects calibrate only justified operational relations; no universal threshold or per-test probability is required.
